Pinned method and limitations

Annual 2023 CAMX regional average factor, applied to each entered month; not a month-specific factor. Operational control; grid-delivered purchased electricity consumed by the reporting company. Market-based Scope 2, Scope 1, Scope 3 and other facilities are not assessed. Factor and method remain unreleased development candidates.
